Tests.Name: A real local process produces complete counters and identity
The duration bound stops a long requested series and retains its first sample
A concurrent writer wins without overwrite or abandoned temporary files
Actual process exit preserves completed samples in a readable report
An exited process returned by enumeration never becomes a sample
Missing target produces a truthful empty report
Sampling failure preserves prior samples and does not claim process exit

Scope: Local process counters and filesystem publication; no Pesto, AD or VM.
